brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: Seven-cell honeycomb (centre plus a full ring of six)

requirements.evidence: 7 top covers (full variant), one on each base: cover:*;full;top.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps. The configurator offered exactly 18 open outside edges (3 on each ring cell) and all 18 are filled. No cap sockets were left open.

requirements.requirement: Bases joined together (needed for a usable surface)
requirements.evidence: 6 joint bolts on the centre cell's walls (jointBolt:0#0,0#0 to 0#5) fixed the LOOSE_BODY warning. The outer cells are not bolted to each other.

finish.summary: Seven-cell honeycomb: 7 full bases, 7 top covers, 18 edge caps and 6 joint bolts (38 parts). check_build found no issues and the mesh check is clear. This checks fit only, not strength.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
